general.title: General settings
general.subtitle: Platform identity, localisation defaults and contact details shown to students.
general.brandingHint: Shown in the student app, emails and receipts.
general.logoHint: PNG or SVG on a transparent background, at least 512 × 512 px.
general.localizationHint: Defaults for new students and for figures across the platform.
general.defaultLanguageHint: Students can switch language from their profile at any time.
general.supportSummaryHint: Shown in the app's Help screen and on receipts.
general.assetsHint: Logo changes are applied to the student app on its next launch and to all new emails immediately.

otp.title: OTP settings
otp.subtitle: Control one-time password delivery, expiry and brute-force protection for student sign-in.
otp.maxAttemptsHint: The account is locked after this many wrong codes.
otp.lockoutHint: Locked numbers can be unlocked earlier by Support.
otp.fallbackHint: Used automatically when the primary provider fails or times out.
otp.policySentence: After {{attempts}} wrong codes the number is locked for {{lockout}} minutes. Students can request up to {{resends}} new codes, one every {{cooldown}} seconds.
otp.devBypassHint: Accepted for the seeded demo student outside production. Leave empty to disable.

flags.title: Feature flags
flags.subtitle: Turn platform features on or off per environment without shipping a new app version.
flags.confirmProdBody: This change affects every student immediately and is recorded in the audit log.
flags.newFlagHint: Flags start in the chosen environment and can be rolled out per platform.
flags.deleteBody: Clients that read this flag fall back to their default behaviour. Type the flag key to confirm.
flags.keyHint: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores, e.g. offline_downloads.
flags.keyInvalid: Start with a letter; 3–41 characters of a–z, 0–9 or _

legal.title: Legal documents
legal.subtitle: Version and publish the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy. Publishing a new version asks students to accept it again.
legal.acceptanceChartHint: Students who accepted each published version.
legal.draftHint: Draft — only visible to admins until published.
legal.retiredHint: Retired — kept for the audit trail.
legal.draftCreated: Draft v{{version}} created from the current version
legal.publishBody: The current version will be retired and all students will be asked to accept the new version on their next sign-in.
legal.noVersionsHint: Create the first version with “New version”.
legal.changeSummaryHint: Shown to students when they are asked to accept the new version.
legal.requireReacceptanceHint: Turn off for typo fixes that do not change the meaning.
legal.acceptancesHint: Students who accepted this version, newest first.

support.title: Support contacts
support.subtitle: How students and parents reach the EDUWAY support team.
support.previewHint: As shown in the student app.

app.title: App settings
app.subtitle: Mobile app versions, maintenance mode and session policy.
app.versionsHint: Students below the minimum version are prompted to update.
app.forceUpdateHint: Block the app until students below the minimum version update.
app.forceUpdateTitle: Force all outdated apps to update?
app.forceUpdateBody: Students on versions older than {{version}} will not be able to use the app until they update.
app.deviceLimitHint: Signing in on another device logs out the oldest session.
app.sessionTimeoutHint: Inactive sessions are signed out after this period.
app.sessionSummary: Each student can stay signed in on {{devices}} device(s); idle sessions expire after {{timeout}}.
app.maintenanceHint: Shows the message below to every student and pauses lessons, quizzes and payments.
app.enableMaintenanceTitle: Take the platform offline for students?
app.enableMaintenanceBody: All students will be signed out of lessons and payments will be paused until maintenance mode is turned off.
app.urlInvalid: Enter a full URL starting with https://
app.appliesToHint: Platforms that show the maintenance screen.

payments.title: Payment settings
payments.subtitle: Gateways offered at checkout, their processing fees and the details printed on receipts.
payments.gatewaysHint: Order sets how methods are listed to students. Fee rates feed reconciliation.
payments.noneEnabled: No real gateway is enabled — students will not be able to pay.
payments.noGateways: No gateways are configured on the server.
payments.receiptHint: Company details and tax note printed on every receipt.
payments.mockGatewayHint: For testing checkout end-to-end. Always off in production.

learning.title: Learning settings
learning.subtitle: Defaults for quizzes, practice, exams and progress used by the website and the mobile app.
learning.quizzesHint: Defaults when a lesson or blueprint has no override.
learning.practiceHint: Session sizes offered in the question bank.
learning.sizesTooBig: Sizes cannot exceed the maximum size
learning.timingHint: How often clients save progress. Lower values mean more requests.
learning.bandsHint: Grade bands by minimum score and the study-minute thresholds of the activity heatmap.
learning.bandsInvalid: Each band needs a unique name and a minimum between 0 and 100
learning.heatmapHint: Ascending thresholds; press Enter after each number.

marketing.title: Marketing settings
marketing.subtitle: Public figures shown on the landing page and in the app, plus store links.
marketing.statsHint: Shown on the landing page, About page and app welcome screen.
marketing.overridesHint: Replace live counters with rounded marketing figures.
marketing.appLinksHint: Used by the website footer and download buttons.
marketing.previewHint: As shown on the landing page.

security.title: Security settings
security.subtitle: Admin sign-in policy for the control centre.
security.mfaMandatoryHint: Admins without MFA must enrol on their next sign-in.
security.mfaConfirmBody: Admins who have not enabled two-factor authentication will be asked to set it up on their next sign-in.
security.mfaOffBody: Admins will be able to sign in with a password only. This weakens account security.
security.sessionsHint: Admins are signed out after this period.
security.passwordPolicy: At least {{count}} characters with upper- and lowercase letters, a digit and a symbol.

cms.title: Testimonials & FAQ
cms.subtitle: Content shown on the landing page, sign-in screens, pricing page and in the mobile app.
cms.question: question
cms.emptyHint: Nothing here yet — add the first item.
cms.activeHint: Inactive items are hidden from students.
